items.title: Sweet Williams Interview
items.q: I know when he come here to stay. Yeah. He was in the Angels building, Billy Smith and Warbats.

ctx.x: You know, he recorded the first time June. Boy, he could play. He recorded the first time in summer 1926. And then you must have been come to Chicago before summer 1926. Uh-huh. This is good.

He might have come here on the record and they didn't stay, but he come here and stay in 19... Oh, yeah. I know when he come here to stay. Yeah. He was in the Angels building, Billy Smith and Warbats.
Oh, yeah. You saw him lying. You see that number, huh?
